moments.label: Rapid strengthening
moments.text: Sustained wind rose from 70 kt to 120 kt over the 24 hours before its peak.

moments.label: Heaviest rain at Asheville
moments.text: The ERA5 reanalysis (a model, not a rain gauge) puts the wettest hour at 24 mm; 362 mm fell in the replay window.

moments.label: Peak wind
moments.text: Highest sustained wind in the replay: 120 kt (138 mph).
moments.src: NHC HURDAT2 best track (6-hourly, interpolated to hours)

moments.label: Lowest pressure
moments.text: Lowest central pressure in the replay: 939 mb.

moments.label: Landfall, Florida Big Bend
moments.text: HURDAT2 marks landfall at 03:10 UTC on 2024-09-27 with 120 kt and 939 mb.

teaches.title: Coast wind, mountain rain
teaches.text: Wind and surge hit the coast within hours of landfall. The rain that flooded the mountains came later and far inland. Look at the wind rings for the coast, then the rain layer for the hills.
